events.rationale: FACT: AUDNZD is at a 5-year extreme because NZDUSD collapsed, not because AUDUSD broke out; AU housing is showing the tightening channel; AONIA still prices ~50bp more hikes; NZ GDP beat and an India FTA have not reversed NZD; VIX crushed after FOMC; WTI is 96th percentile with a two-way energy narrative; NZ yields are missing; no FX option marks exist. INFERENCE: the market is pricing a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime that is already internally inconsistent, so the next move is a distribution with both a delayed mean-reversion tail and a squeeze tail. Spot is dominated because timing is uncertain and event risk (housing prints, energy, next RBA/RBNZ, residual global hike path) is two-sided after realized FX vol stayed ~5%. UNKNOWN: 3M ATMF IV, 25d risk-reversal, quoted premium, and the RBNZ curve — all must be checked before any OPEN. The paper book therefore HOLDs; the debate trade is still the put.
